Santosh Trophy 2026 schedule announced

The Example Football Federation has announced the schedule for the 80th edition of the Santosh Trophy. The group stage will begin on 10 March 2026 in Kochi, with 36 state teams divided into six groups.

The final round will be played at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium from 1 April. Registration of squads closes on 20 February.
